title: Senior Group Accountant (f/m/d)
announcement: Purpose of Position As Senior Group Accountant, you will play a key role in ensuring accurate, timely and high-quality consolidated financial reporting for the Awin Group under IFRS. You will take ownership of key consolidation and reporting processes, support group-wide accounting topics, and contribute to the continuous improvement of our reporting systems and processes.   Key Responsibilities   Perform and review group consolidation activities and IFRS reporting for the Awin Group Coordinate and support monthly and annual group closing activities Prepare and review intercompany reconciliations, group reporting packages and related group-level deliverables Prepare financial analysis and management reporting to support transparent and reliable group-level insights Support and coordinate audit requests as well as shareholder reporting requirements related to group reporting and consolidation Drive process and system improvements in the group reporting and consolidation landscape Act as a point of contact for local finance teams on group-wide IFRS and consolidation-related accounting topics Act as process owner for Awin’s consolidation tool LucaNet This role offers the opportunity to take ownership of key group reporting processes and contribute to the further development of Awin’s international finance and consolidation landscape.   Key Skills At least 5 years of professional experience in a comparable group accounting, consolidation or audit-related role Strong knowledge of consolidation processes, including intercompany reconciliation, reporting packages and group-level financial statements Strong practical knowledge of IFRS and good understanding of local GAAP requirements; tax knowledge is beneficial but not essential Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and practical experience with ERP, reporting and consolidation tools such as Microsoft D365 and LucaNet Team player with a global mindset and the ability to build international working relationships. Structured, accurate and proactive way of working, with the ability to deliver high-quality results in a dynamic environment Ability to work under pressure and prioritise effectively during tight reporting deadlines. Experience in group accounting, consolidation or audit environment preferred Professional qualification such as CPA, ACCA, ACA, IFRS Accountant, German “Bilanzbuchhalter” is an advantage Very good written and verbal communication skills in English, combined with strong analytical and interpersonal skills (company language: English) Further languages (Romanian/German) are an advantage   Our Offer  Flexi-Week : We prioritise your mental health and wellbeing by offering you a four-day Flexi-Week (with one lighter or completely disconnected day per week) at full pay, with no reduction to your annual holiday allowance. Flexi-Office : We offer an international culture and flexibility through our hybrid working model, designed to foster collaboration, trust, and autonomy. Work Expense Contribution & Remote Working Furniture : You will receive a monthly allowance to cover part of your running costs, as well as a furniture package to support you in setting up a comfortable workspace at home. Pension: Awin offers access to an additional pension insurance to all employees in Germany and contributes regularly to your retirement savings. Business Bike Leasing : Take advantage of our bike leasing scheme and support a more sustainable way of commuting. Benefit Selection Scheme : After 3 years of service, you can choose from a range of benefits up to a value of €900 per year.   In addition, you’ll benefit from our global offering, including health and wellbeing initiatives, learning and development via Awin Academy, and peer-to-peer recognition programmes. Established in 2000, Awin is proud of our dynamic, social and inclusive culture. Like all businesses, we’ve had to adapt and nurture our culture in a virtual environment. Our virtual ‘Life @ Awin’ hub brings our colleagues from across the globe together for various social activities. Diversity & Inclusion are paramount to us, and we proudly pursue and hire diverse team members. We champion uniqueness and authenticity; this is who we are at our core. Our network of affiliate partnerships are diverse and transparent, as are the employees powering our vision to build the world’s leading open partner ecosystem. We welcome all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. If you need support at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know. Awin is part of the Axel Springer group. Learn more at  axelspringer.com/ en / , and explore the Axel Springer Essentials here: axelspriger.com/en/inside/the-essentials-what-we-have-adapted-and-why     Apply now to begin the next stage of your career at a progressive company that supports both your professional and personal development.     #LI-DR1   Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow
